title: Vitalik: Low-Risk DeFi Could Be Ethereum’s Google Search
summary: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin believes the network’s long-term sustainability may depend on an unlikely hero — low-risk decentralized finance protocols. The post Vitalik: Low-Risk DeFi Could Be Ethereum’s Google Search appeared first on Cryptonews .

title: Trump nominates White House aide to be top US prosecutor for office probing Letitia James
summary: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he would be nominating senior White House aide Lindsey Halligan to serve as the top federal prosecutor for the Virginia office that was thrown into turmoil when its U.S. attorney was pushed out Friday.

title: India’s Goyal to Visit US in Bid for ‘Mutually Beneficial’ Deal
summary: India’s Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal will visit the US on Monday with the view of getting a “mutually beneficial” trade deal, in a sign of easing tensions over tariffs and New Delhi’s purchases of Russian oil.
